data.standardized_narrative: In 2014, Syndicate 1458 recognized a gross favourable development of GBP 8.7 million on prior accident year losses. This release was primarily driven by a GBP 2.6 million reduction in the estimated ultimate loss for Storm Sandy (2012), a GBP 3.5 million reduction from other large and small catastrophe events, and a GBP 2.6 million favourable development on attritional gross claims and claim expenses due to reported claims activity coming in lower than expected.
